inputs.prompt: Repaint the first image as a photographic film still from a first-person point of view. Keep its exact composition: we look out from inside the dark round mouth of a padded tube slide, its worn tan plastic walls framing the view in a circle, out over a vast hazy space, with the giant figure standing far off in the middle and a ball pit below. The space beyond the mouth is exactly the place in the second image, with the same design, materials, lighting and color: a colossal indoor play place packed with fat enclosed tube slides in faded red, orange, blue and green knotting through every gap, sagging rope-net catwalks sweeping overhead, green steel-mesh caged towers, clear plastic bubble pods, towers of small amber-lit windows repeating into blue haze, single red lamps, slides spilling into a sea of red, yellow, blue and green balls. Match the second image's lighting exactly: cold blue haze, warm amber practicals, pools of black shadow. The giant figure far off is the mascot statue from the third image: a glossy orange cartoon mascot with round ears, a yellow belly and a fixed wide grin, standing perfectly still between the towers, small with distance but clearly the size of a building, half veiled by haze and by tubes passing in front of it. Exactly one mascot and no others. Uncanny, airless, perfectly still and empty. Photographic 35mm film, 1990s film grain, slight halation. No people, no hands, no text, no signage, no logos.
